import imaplib,os,re
m=imaplib.IMAP4(os.environ['NODE1_IP'],143)
print 'CONNECTED=%s:143' % os.environ['NODE1_IP']
print 'LOGIN=%s' % m.login('archive',os.environ['DEMO_PASS'])[0]
m.select('INBOX',readonly=True); t,d=m.search(None,'ALL')
print 'COUNT=%d' % len(d[0].split())
for n in d[0].split():
 t,p=m.fetch(n,'(FLAGS RFC822)'); h=p[0][0]; x=p[0][1]
 mid=re.search(r'Message-ID: ([^\r\n]+)',x,re.I).group(1)
 flags=re.search(r'FLAGS \(([^)]*)\)',h).group(1)
 body=x.split('\r\n\r\n',1)[1].strip()
 print 'MESSAGE=%s FLAGS=(%s) BODY=%s' % (mid,flags,body)
print 'LOGOUT=%s' % m.logout()[0]
PY
